gettingStarted.title: Getting Started on Vigil
gettingStarted.description: Learn the basics about using Vigil

overview.title: System Overview
overview.description: Understand Vigil's architecture and main features
overview.fullContent:
Vigil is a complete social platform combining social networking features, real-time communication, and educational content. Here you can create posts, join communities, chat with other users, and access exclusive content.

What you can do on Vigil:

Publish content: Create posts with text, images, videos, audio, polls, and evidence boards. Share your ideas and interact with the community through likes, comments, and shares.

Join communities: Join thematic communities on subjects of interest. Each community may have different access requirements based on your subscription plan.

Real-time chat: Send private messages to other users or join public chat rooms (available for Premium and Pro subscribers).

Explore historical content: Navigate the interactive historical timeline and learn about important past events.

Access exclusive library: Subscribers have access to e-books, articles, and educational documents (available from the Basic plan).

Create ads: Promote your content or business through the integrated advertising system.

Available plans:
- Free: Basic access to all main features
- Basic ($3.99/mo): Basic Communities + Basic Library
- Premium ($8.99/mo): Chat Rooms + Complete Library
- Pro ($19.99/mo): All features + Advertising Dashboard

To get started, explore the main feed, join communities, and customize your profile in settings.

authentication.title: Authentication and Account
authentication.description: How to create an account, log in, and recover password
authentication.fullContent:
How to create your account and log in to Vigil:

Create a new account:
1. Click "Create account" on the home page
2. Fill in your email, choose a unique username, and create a strong password
3. You will receive a confirmation email - click the link to activate your account
4. Done! Your account is created and you can start using Vigil

Log in:
Enter your email or username and password. Your session will remain active even if you close the browser, so you don't need to log in every time you access Vigil.

Forgot your password?
1. Click "Forgot my password" on the login screen
2. Enter your registered email
3. You will receive an email with a link to reset your password
4. The link is valid for 1 hour - create a new password and log in normally

Security tips:
- Use a strong password with letters, numbers, and symbols
- Do not share your password with anyone
- If you suspect your account has been compromised, change your password immediately in settings

Your account and data are protected with top-notch encryption. All passwords are stored securely and never shared.

Need help? Contact support@myvigil.co

layout.title: Navigation and Interface
layout.description: Get to know the interface and how to navigate the app
layout.fullContent:
How to navigate Vigil and find what you need:

At the top of the page you will find:
- Vigil Logo (click to return to main feed)
- Search bar to find posts, people, and communities
- Notification icon (bell) showing your recent interactions
- Your profile picture with quick options menu

Left Sidebar:
Here are the main shortcuts to navigate the app:
- Home: Main feed with posts from people you follow
- Profile: Your personal profile
- Communities: All available communities
- Messages: Private conversations
- Chat Rooms: Chat rooms (Premium)
- Library: Educational content (Basic+)
- Timeline: Historical timeline
- Settings: Your account settings

Right Sidebar:
Shows currently trending topics and suggestions of people to follow. It's a great way to discover new and interesting content.

On mobile:
Navigation is at the bottom of the screen for easy one-handed access. Main icons remain visible while you navigate.

Themes:
You can switch between light and dark mode in settings. Dark mode is default and helps reduce eye strain, especially at night.

Vigil is designed to work perfectly on any device - computer, tablet, or mobile.

creatingContent.title: Creating Content
creatingContent.description: Publish posts, create communities and share

posts.title: Post System
posts.description: How to create posts with text, images, videos, polls and evidence
posts.fullContent:
How to create and interact with posts on Vigil:

Create a new post:
1. Click the "+" button at the top of the feed or the "What's on your mind?" field
2. Write your text (up to 5000 characters)
3. Add extra content if you wish:
   - Photos: Click the image icon to add one or multiple photos
   - Video: Add videos from your device
   - Audio: Record or upload audio files
   - Poll: Create a vote with up to 4 options and set duration
   - Evidence Board: Organize information in visual cards
4. Click "Publish"

Tip: If you start creating a poll or evidence board and change your mind, use the "Cancel" button that appears to return to normal post.

Interact with posts:
- Like: Click the heart to show appreciation
- Comment: Share your opinion or reply to the post
- Share: Repost to your profile
- Save: Keep the post to read later (bookmark icon)
- Report: Report inappropriate content

Special features:
- Use # to create hashtags and make your post easier to find
- Use @ to mention other users
- Mark sensitive content to add a warning before displaying
- You can edit your posts after publishing

Where your post appears:
Choose whether your post will be public (everyone sees), followers only, or in a specific community.

Your posts are your voice on Vigil - share ideas, opinions, and content that adds value to the community!

communities.title: Communities
communities.fullContent:
Communities are spaces dedicated to specific topics where you can connect with people who share your interests.

How to join a community:
1. Go to the "Communities" page in the sidebar
2. Browse available communities or use search
3. Click a community to see details
4. Click "Join" to become a member
5. Now you can see and create posts in that community

Community types:
Some communities are public and open to all. Others require specific subscription plans:
- Free Communities: Open to everyone
- Basic Communities: Require Basic plan or higher
- Premium Communities: Require Premium or Pro plan
- Pro Communities: Pro subscribers only

Create your own community:
If you have a specific topic or interest, you can create your own community! Click "Create Community", choose a name, description, and define if it will be public or restricted to certain plans.

As a community moderator you can:
- Edit community information
- Moderate posts and comments
- Remove inappropriate content
- Manage members

Tip: Vigil Administrators have access to all communities to ensure rules are followed.

Communities are the heart of Vigil - find yours and be part of meaningful discussions!

timeline.title: Historical Timeline
timeline.description: Explore historical events on the interactive timeline
timeline.fullContent:
The Historical Timeline is an interactive timeline presenting important historical events visually and chronologically.

How it works:
Access "Timeline" in the sidebar to see a timeline with historical events organized chronologically. Each event shows:
- Date of occurrence
- Event title and description
- Related images
- Links to sources and more information

Navigate the timeline:
Scroll to travel through time. You can move forward or backward to explore different historical periods. Use zoom to see more or fewer events at once.

Event types:
The timeline includes various types of events:
- Political events (elections, treaties, wars)
- Cultural milestones (art movements, important publications)
- Scientific discoveries
- Technological advances
- Social movements

Filter events:
Use filters to see only events from a specific period or category. This helps focus on what you are studying or researching.

Search events:
Use search to find specific events quickly. Type a keyword and see all related events.

Interact with events:
- Comment on events to share your perspective or ask questions
- Share interesting events with your followers
- Add events to favorites for later reference
- Suggest corrections if you find inaccurate information

Educational tool:
The Timeline is perfect for students, teachers, and anyone interested in history. Use it to learn, teach, and discuss important historical events.

New events are regularly added by our team of moderators and administrators.

messages.title: Private Messages
messages.fullContent:
Chat directly with other users through private messages.

How to send a message:
1. Click the message icon in the sidebar or header
2. Click "New message" or choose an existing conversation
3. Type your message and press Enter or click send
4. You can also send images by clicking the image icon

Messages are delivered in real-time - when the other person is online, you can chat instantly like in any messaging app.

Useful features:
- See when the other person is typing (shows "typing..." in chat)
- Know if the person is online or when they were last seen
- All your conversations are saved in history
- Unread messages appear with a notification badge

Search conversations:
Use the search bar at the top of the message list to quickly find a specific conversation.

Privacy and security:
- If someone is bothering you, you can block the user in settings
- You can delete conversations you no longer want to see
- Report inappropriate conversations to our moderation team

Notifications:
You will receive notifications of new messages even when not using Vigil. Configure how you want to receive these notifications in Settings > Notifications.

Private messages are perfect for more personal and direct conversations with other community members!

chatRooms.title: Chat Rooms
chatRooms.fullContent:
Chat Rooms are group chat rooms where you can interact with multiple users at once. This feature is available for Premium and Pro subscribers.

How to use Chat Rooms:
1. Access "Chat Rooms" in the sidebar
2. View the list of available rooms
3. Click a room to enter
4. Start chatting with members present

Room types:
- Public Rooms: Any Premium or Pro subscriber can enter
- Private Rooms: Only invited members can participate
- Temporary Rooms: Exist for 24 hours and then disappear
- Permanent Rooms: Always available

Special indicators:
- 🌟 New: Recently created rooms
- 🔥 Hot: Rooms with high activity right now

Radar Feature (Geolocation):
If you allow access to your location, you can see other users near you who are also using Chat. It's an interesting way to connect with people in your region. You can enable or disable this at any time in privacy settings.

Online members:
See who is active in the room right now. The member list shows all participants present in real-time.

Create your own room:
Premium and Pro subscribers can create their own chat rooms, public or private, temporary or permanent.

Moderation:
Room moderators can keep the environment healthy by removing inappropriate messages or banning users who do not follow rules.

Chat Rooms are perfect for group discussions, live events, and meeting new community members!

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.fullContent:
Stay on top of everything happening on Vigil through the notification system.

What you get notifications for:
- When someone likes your post
- When someone comments on your post
- When someone mentions you using @yourname
- When someone starts following you
- When you receive a private message
- When someone replies to your comment
- When there are new posts in communities you follow

How to see your notifications:
Click the bell icon at the top of the page. A red number shows how many unread notifications you have. The list shows all your recent notifications in chronological order.

Notification types:
- In-app: You see a badge with the number of unread notifications
- Push: Receive alerts on your device even when not using Vigil
- Email: Receive summaries by email (you choose frequency)

Customize notifications:
Go to Settings > Notifications to choose:
- Which types of notification you want to receive
- If you want sounds and vibrations
- How often you want emails
- Set a quiet time (e.g., no notifications at night)

Manage notifications:
- Click a notification to see related content
- Mark notifications as read
- Use "Clear all" to remove old notifications

Notifications help you stay connected and miss no important interaction on the platform!

search.title: Advanced Search
search.fullContent:
Quickly find what you're looking for on Vigil using advanced search.

How to search:
Use the search bar at the top of the page. Type any keyword and press Enter. You can search for:
- Posts: Find posts containing certain words or hashtags
- Users: Search people by name or username
- Communities: Find communities by name or description
- Hashtags: See all popular hashtags

Refine your search:
After searching, you can use filters to find exactly what you need:
- Filter by date: Today, this week, this month, or this year
- Filter by type: Posts with images, videos, polls, etc.
- Filter by community: See only results from a specific community
- Filter by user: See only posts from a specific user

Sort results:
Choose whether you want to see most relevant results first or most recent.

Smart features:
- Autocomplete: As you type, suggestions appear automatically
- History: Your recent searches are saved for quick access
- Hashtag suggestions: See hashtags related to what you're searching

Search tips:
- Use # before a word to search only by hashtag (e.g., #technology)
- Use @ before a name to search users (e.g., @john)
- Put phrases in quotes to search exact phrase (e.g., "artificial intelligence")

The search is constantly updated, so you'll always find the most recent content!

profile.title: User Profile
profile.description: Customize your profile and view others' profiles
profile.fullContent:
Your profile is your identity on Vigil - it's how other users know you and find your content.

What appears on your profile:
- Profile picture and banner (cover image)
- Your display name and username (@yourname)
- Bio: A brief description about you
- Location (optional)
- Link to your website or social media (optional)
- Date you joined Vigil
- Your recent posts
- Stats: number of posts, followers, and people you follow

Special badges:
Some profiles display badges indicating special status:
- ✓ Verified: Authentic public figure account
- Moderator: Member of moderation team
- Premium/Pro: Shows your subscription plan

Edit your profile:
1. Click your profile picture and select "Profile"
2. Click "Edit profile"
3. Change your photo, banner, bio, and other information
4. Click "Save"

View other users' profiles:
Click any user's name or photo to see their profile. There you can:
- See all public posts from the person
- Follow or unfollow
- Send a private message
- Block (if necessary)
- Report (if there is inappropriate content)

Privacy:
In settings you can define if your profile is public (anyone sees) or private (only approved followers see your posts).

Your profile is your showcase on Vigil - keep it updated and interesting!

trending.title: Trending Topics
trending.description: Discover saved posts and popular topics
trending.fullContent:
Discover additional features that make your experience on Vigil even better!

Saved Posts:
Found an interesting post but don't have time to read now? Save for later!
- Click the bookmark icon on any post
- Access "Saved" in the sidebar to see all saved posts
- Organize posts in collections by theme
- Use search to find specific saved posts
- Remove saved posts when no longer needed

Trending Topics:
See what's being discussed right now on Vigil:
- Access "Trending Topics" in the menu or right sidebar
- See the most popular hashtags of the moment
- Filter by period: last hour, today, this week
- Click any hashtag to see all related posts
- Discover new content and join trending conversations

Topic Details:
When you click a hashtag, you see:
- All posts that used this hashtag
- Stats: how many posts, how many people participating
- Option to follow the topic to receive notifications of new posts
- Sort by relevance or date

Explore Users:
Find interesting people to follow:
- Suggestions based on who you already follow
- Popular users in specific categories
- Filters by interests
- View profiles and decide who to follow

About Vigil:
Want to know more about the platform?
- History: How Vigil started
- Mission and values: What motivates us
- Team: Meet who makes Vigil happen
- Contact: Ways to contact us

Splash Screen:
The loading screen you see when opening Vigil:
- Animated logo
- Loading your data
- Smooth transition to feed

These additional features were created to improve your experience and help you discover more relevant content on Vigil!

plans.title: Plans and Subscriptions
plans.description: Learn about Premium, Pro and Basic plans
plans.fullContent:
Vigil offers different plans to suit your needs. Choose the one that best fits your usage!

Free Plan:
Perfect for starting and getting to know the platform:
- Create unlimited posts
- Join public communities
- Send private messages
- Use basic search
- Access main feed

Basic Plan - $3.99/mo:
For those who want more features:
- All Free plan features
- Access to Basic communities
- Basic content library
- Ad-free experience
- Priority support

Premium Plan - $8.99/mo:
For engaged users:
- All Basic plan features
- Access to Chat Rooms
- Complete library
- Premium badge on profile
- Quick response support
- Exclusive features

Pro Plan - $19.99/mo:
For creators and professionals:
- All Premium plan features
- Complete advertising dashboard
- Exclusive content and early access
- Advanced analytics
- Pro badge on profile
- Maximum priority support

How to subscribe:
1. Go to Settings > Premium
2. Choose desired plan
3. Click "Subscribe"
4. Fill in credit card details
5. Confirm subscription

Secure payment:
We use Stripe, one of the world's most secure payment platforms. Your card details are encrypted and never stored on our servers.

Automatic renewal:
Your subscription renews automatically every month. You will receive an email a few days before renewal.

Cancel subscription:
You can cancel anytime in Settings > Premium > Manage Subscription. You will continue to have access to features until the end of the paid period.

Upgrade or downgrade:
Changed your mind? You can switch plans anytime. Upgrade is immediate. On downgrade, you keep benefits until the end of current period.

Refund:
If you cancel within the first 7 days, we offer prorated refund. Contact support@myvigil.co

Try 7 days free of Premium plan to know all features!

library.title: Content Library
library.description: Access exclusive e-books, articles and documents
library.fullContent:
The Vigil Library offers access to exclusive educational content for subscribers. It's like having a digital library always at hand!

What you find in the library:
- PDF and EPUB e-books on various topics
- Long and in-depth articles
- Technical and academic documents
- Educational videos
- Podcasts and audiobooks

Available categories:
History, Politics, Science, Technology, Philosophy, Literature, and more. All content is carefully selected to add value and knowledge.

How to use the library:
1. Access "Library" in the sidebar
2. Browse categories or use search
3. Click an item to see details
4. Read online or download to read offline

Useful features:
- Bookmark your favorite pages
- Make notes while reading
- Your reading progress is saved automatically
- Add items to favorites to find quickly later

Access by plan:
- Basic Plan: Access to basic library with essential content
- Premium Plan: Full access to the entire library
- Pro Plan: All Premium content + exclusive materials and early access to new releases

The library is updated regularly with new content. It's an excellent tool for continuous learning and personal development!

Available for Basic, Premium, and Pro subscribers.

advertising.title: Advertising Dashboard
advertising.fullContent:
Promote your content, product, or service on Vigil through the integrated advertising system.

How to create an ad:
1. Access "Advertising" in the menu or go to "My Ads"
2. Click "Create New Ad"
3. Fill in information:
   - Catchy title (up to 100 characters)
   - Description of what you are promoting
   - Add an attractive image or video
   - Insert link where you want to take people
4. Define your budget:
   - Daily budget (how much you want to spend per day)
   - Campaign duration (how many days the ad will be active)
5. Submit for approval

Ad approval:
All ads go through a review by our team before being published. This ensures content is appropriate and follows our guidelines. You will receive a notification when your ad is approved or if it needs adjustments.

Track performance:
In the Advertising Dashboard you see detailed metrics for each ad:
- Impressions: How many times your ad was displayed
- Clicks: How many people clicked your ad
- Click-through rate (CTR): Percentage of people who clicked
- Engagement: Total interactions with the ad
- Total Cost: How much you spent so far
- Average CPC: Average cost per click

Filter results:
Choose to see metrics for a specific ad or all your ads together. You can also filter by period to see performance on specific days.

Performance chart:
A chart shows daily evolution of your impressions and clicks, helping you understand when your ad performs best.

Ad status:
- Pending: Awaiting team approval
- Active: Being displayed to users
- Paused: Temporarily stopped (you can reactivate)
- Ended: Campaign finished
- Rejected: Not approved (see reason and adjust)

Manage ads:
You can pause, edit, or end your ads at any time. Adjust your strategy based on the results you are seeing.

The advertising system is available to all Vigil users!

settings.title: Settings
settings.fullContent:
Customize your Vigil experience through settings. Access via sidebar or clicking your avatar > Settings.

Account Settings:
- Edit profile: Change photo, banner, bio, and other info
- Change password: Change your password anytime
- Email: Update your contact email
- Delete account: Permanently remove your account and data

Privacy:
Control who sees your content and how they interact with you:
- Private profile: Only approved followers see your posts
- Who can follow me: Everyone or only who you approve
- Who can send me messages: Everyone, followers only, or no one
- Location sharing: Enable/disable for Chat Rooms

Notifications:
Choose how and when you want to be notified:
- Push notifications: Alerts on device
- Email: Receive summaries by email (daily, weekly, or never)
- Sounds and vibrations: Enable/disable sound feedback
- Quiet hours: Set a period without notifications (e.g., 10 PM to 7 AM)
- By type: Choose which notification types you want to receive

Appearance:
Customize interface:
- Theme: Choose between light or dark mode
- Font size: Adjust for better reading
- Language: Select your preferred language

Blocks and Filters:
Control what you see:
- Blocked users: List of people you blocked
- Blocked words: Hide posts with certain words
- Muted communities: Don't see posts from specific communities

Subscription (if applicable):
Manage your plan:
- See current plan and benefits
- Payment history and invoices
- Upgrade or downgrade
- Cancel subscription

Security:
Monitor your account:
- Active sessions: See where you are logged in
- Account activity: Login history
- Two-factor authentication: Coming soon for greater security

Tip: Review your privacy settings regularly to ensure you are sharing only what you want!

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.fullContent:
Vigil maintains a healthy and safe environment through an active moderation system.

How to report inappropriate content:
If you find a post, comment, or user violating our rules:
1. Click the three dots (...) on the content
2. Select "Report"
3. Choose reason for report
4. Add details if necessary
5. Submit report

Our moderation team will review the report within 24 hours.

What is considered violation:
- Spam or repetitive content
- Hate speech or discrimination
- Harassment or bullying
- Unmarked adult content
- Deliberate misinformation
- Copyright infringement
- Threats or incitement to violence

Moderation actions:
Depending on severity of violation, our team may:
- Remove specific content
- Send a warning to user
- Suspend account temporarily
- Permanently ban in severe cases

Appeals System:
If you received a moderation action and believe it was a mistake:
1. Access "Appeals" in settings
2. Select action you want to contest
3. Explain why you believe it was unfair
4. Submit appeal

Our team will review your case and respond within 48 hours. If appeal is accepted, action will be reversed.

Moderation team:
- Administrators: Full access to moderation system
- Moderators: Review reports and take actions
- Community Moderators: Moderate specific communities

Transparency:
You will always receive a notification explaining any moderation action taken on your content or account, including specific reason.

Help keep Vigil safe by reporting inappropriate content when you find it!

policies.title: Policies and Terms
policies.description: Privacy, terms of service and cookies
policies.fullContent:
Understand how Vigil works and how we protect your data.

Terms of Service:
Defines rules for platform use, your rights, and responsibilities as user. By using Vigil, you agree to these terms. Key points:
- You are responsible for content you publish
- You retain rights to your content but give us license to display it
- You must be at least 13 years old to use Vigil
- You cannot use Vigil for illegal activities
- We can remove content violating our rules

Privacy Policy:
Explains what data we collect and how we use it:
- Registration data: Email, name, username
- Usage data: Posts, likes, comments, communities
- Technical data: IP, device, browser
- We use your data only to improve your experience
- We never sell your data to third parties
- You can request a copy of your data anytime
- You can delete your account and all associated data

Your rights (LGPD/GDPR):
- Right to access your data
- Right to correct incorrect data
- Right to delete your data
- Right to port your data
- Right to revoke consents

Cookie Policy:
We use cookies to:
- Keep you logged in
- Remember your preferences
- Analyze how you use Vigil
- Improve your experience

You can disable cookies in your browser, but some functionalities may not work correctly.

Content Policy:
Defines what is allowed and prohibited on Vigil:
- Prohibited: Spam, hate speech, harassment, illegal content
- Adult content must be marked appropriately
- Respect copyrights
- Be respectful to other users

Accessibility:
We are committed to making Vigil accessible to everyone. If you find accessibility barriers, contact us.

Full documents:
Access full legal documents via links in page footer:
- Terms of Service
- Privacy Policy
- Cookie Policy
- Content Policy
- Accessibility

For specific legal questions, contact: legal@myvigil.co

supportSystem.title: Support System
supportSystem.description: How to create tickets and get help
supportSystem.fullContent:
Need help? Our support team is here for you!

How to open a support ticket:
1. Click the floating support button (headset icon in bottom right corner)
2. Fill out the form with:
   - Subject: Summarize your problem in a few words
   - Description: Explain in detail what is happening
   - Category: Choose type (Bug, Question, Suggestion, Complaint, etc.)
3. Click "Submit Ticket"

You will receive a confirmation email with your ticket number. Use this number to track status.

Response time:
Our response time varies according to your plan:
- Free Plan: Up to 48 hours
- Basic Plan: Up to 24 hours
- Premium Plan: Up to 12 hours
- Pro Plan: Up to 6 hours (top priority)

Track your ticket:
You will receive notifications when our team responds. You can also access your open tickets in Settings > Support.

Other ways to get help:
- Direct Email: suporte@myvigil.co
- Help Center: This page with answers to common questions
- Community: Ask questions in "Vigil Support" community

Tips for faster service:
- Be specific when describing the problem
- Include screenshots if possible
- Mention which device and browser you are using
- If it's a bug, describe steps to reproduce the problem
- State your current plan

Ticket status:
- Open: We received your ticket
- In analysis: Our team is investigating
- Answered: We sent a response, waiting for your reply
- Resolved: Problem solved
- Closed: Ticket finalized

Our team works every day to ensure you have the best experience on Vigil. Don't hesitate to contact us!
